title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Juan Lumosad Memorial National High School - Monte Alegre Annex in Barangay Monthe Alegre, Municipality of Aurora, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur to Monte Alegre National High School

text.en: The name of the Juan Lumosad Memorial National High School - Monte Alegre Annex in Barangay Monte Alegre, Municipality of Aurora, Province of Zamboanga del Sure is hereby changed to Monte Alegre National High School.
The main campus of the Monte Alegre National High School shall continue to remain in tis present location in Barangay Monte Alegre, Municipality of Aurora, Province of Zamboanga del Sur.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
